activities.name: Victoria Falls
activities.note: high water and low water are different sights, not better and worse ones — one is spray and thunder, the other is bare rock and a clear view of the gorge

windows.reason: peak flow, about 500 million litres a minute in April — though the spray can hide the falls from the viewpoints
the lowest flow of the year; on parts of the Zambian side no water falls at all
